lyrics:
[Intro: pounding distorted kick, buzzing bass, warning beep]

[Verse 1: distorted male shout]
Do not open
Do not look inside
No user-serviceable parts
Do not even try

[Chorus: full beat, gang shout]
This will void your warranty!
This will void your warranty!
Break the seal and you are on your own
This will void your warranty!

[Verse 2: shout, synth screeching]
Twelve small screws
One you cannot find
A sticker says they'll know
A sticker reads your mind

[Chorus: full beat, gang shout]
This will void your warranty!
This will void your warranty!
Break the seal and you are on your own
This will void your warranty!

[Breakdown: kick only, calm spoken voice]
Please contact an authorized service center.

[Final Chorus: loudest, screamed]
This will void your warranty!
I will void my warranty!
I broke the seal and I am on my own
I voided my warranty!

[Outro: beat stops, a screwdriver dropped, "It works."]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 135 BPM, 4/4, F minor. Pounding, harsh and relentless, built for a strobe-lit floor.

VOICE: Male, shouted and screamed through heavy distortion, like a megaphone. A gang shouts the chorus. One calm, clean corporate voice speaks a sentence in the breakdown. A normal spoken voice says two words at the very end.

INSTRUMENTS: A heavily distorted four-on-the-floor kick, a buzzing sawtooth bass on every off-beat, screeching lead synths, a hard clap, noise sweeps, an alarm-like warning beep, a dropped screwdriver.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, kick, bass and beep. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:36 Chorus 1. 1:00 Verse 2. 1:22 Chorus 2. 1:46 Breakdown, the calm voice. 2:00 Final chorus. 2:36 Outro, silence, a screwdriver and 'It works' at 2:52.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2005 aggrotech: everything distorted and compressed to the limit, kick enormous, no space left.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'It works.' in the silence at 2:52.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is a threat with no object. This aims the same fury at a warning label, and ends with the listener fixing the thing himself.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Warned, enraged, defiant, satisfied.
